roleTitle: Registered Nurse (RN) - Staff Development & Infection Control
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, focusing on both staff development and infection control. This vital role involves ensuring our clinical team is well-trained and up-to-date on best practices, while also leading our efforts to maintain a safe and healthy environment for all residents and staff.

As the Staff Development and Infection Control Nurse, you will play a crucial part in upholding the highest standards of care and compliance. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced RN to make a significant impact within a supportive and professional setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and clinical education
Demonstrated expertise in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations

description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier 120-bed skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to join a recently acquired facility with a current census of 75, offering significant potential for growth and impact. We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented leader who is eager to drive market development and enhance community presence.The ideal candidate will be a highly presentable and professional individual with a strong drive to succeed. This role requires a commitment to occasional weekend work to support facility events and outreach initiatives. We offer a highly competitive compensation package for the right candidate, reflecting the importance of this leadership position.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing and outreach strategies.
Professional demeanor and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Proactive and results-driven approach to market development and census growth.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends for facility events and community engagement.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Highly competitive compensation for the right candidate, based on experience.

description:
Join a leading health services provider in Greenville, SC, as a Family Medicine Physician. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package starting at $210,000 annually, with an additional bonus structure up to $50,000. We are committed to supporting our physicians with great benefits, generous paid time off, and a recently revamped compensation and raise structure designed to reward your expertise and dedication.

We are actively seeking talented MDs and DOs, with a preference for Family Medicine specialists, though Internal Medicine and Med/Ped candidates are also encouraged to apply. This opportunity is open to candidates interested in travel or relocation, and we offer a significant sign-on/relocation bonus to support your transition.

This is an urgent opening for a physician who is passionate about delivering high-quality patient care within a supportive and dynamic environment. Take advantage of this exceptional chance to advance your career with a compensation package that significantly exceeds the state average.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Ped
Valid state medical license in South Carolina or ability to obtain one
Experience in a family medicine setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $210,000 per year, with a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional potential $25,000 bonus. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available on payday one upon signing a promissory note. Total bonus structure up to $50,000.
